# Run Contract — go-chi/chi v1.5.8

> Generated by [Quality Playbook](https://github.com/andrewstellman/quality-playbook) v1.6.0 — Andrew Stellman
> Date: 2026-07-19 · Project: go-chi/chi v1.5.8

This file records **the Quality Playbook's own run-layout invariants for this run** — where
this audit places its artifacts on disk. These are not requirements of the audited system.
go-chi/chi neither knows nor cares where `quality/writeups/` lives; a reader looking for chi's
behavioral specification wants `quality/REQUIREMENTS.md` instead.

These records live in the same `quality/requirements_manifest.json` as the product
requirements and remain gate-enforced per run. Only their rendering destination differs: a REQ
whose `references[]` point exclusively into `quality/` is a tool-contract REQ and renders here.

## Canonical Artifact Locations

These requirements pin the canonical on-disk layout the Phase 6 gate enforces. Each names one
artifact class and the single path it is written to; the gate fails a run that files an
artifact anywhere else.

### REQ-009: Per-bug writeup placement under quality/writeups/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Per-bug writeups are placed at `quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md`.
- References: quality/writeups/

### REQ-010: Fix patch placement under quality/patches/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Fix patches are placed at `quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch`.
- References: quality/patches/

### REQ-011: Regression-test patch placement under quality/patches/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Regression-test patches are placed at `quality/patches/BUG-<id>-regression-test.patch`.
- References: quality/patches/

### REQ-012: Code review output placement under quality/code_reviews/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Code review output is placed at `quality/code_reviews/`.
- References: quality/code_reviews/

### REQ-013: Spec audit output placement under quality/spec_audits/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Spec audit outputs (auditor reports + triage) are placed at `quality/spec_audits/`.
- References: quality/spec_audits/

### REQ-014: Sidecar JSON result placement under quality/results/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Sidecar JSON results (`tdd-results.json`, `integration-results.json`, `recheck-results.json`) are placed at `quality/results/`.
- References: quality/results/

### REQ-015: Mechanical-verification artifact placement under quality/mechanical/
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - Mechanical-verification artifacts (`verify.py` + `*_cases.txt`) are placed at `quality/mechanical/`.
- References: quality/mechanical/

### REQ-016: Flat top-level quality/<name>/ layout with no workspace/ tree
- Conditions of satisfaction:
  - `quality/workspace/<name>/` is forbidden — top-level `quality/<name>/` is the only canonical layout.
  - The Phase 6 gate check `check_no_workspace_dir` fails any run with a `quality/workspace/` tree present, populated OR empty. An empty `workspace/` trains future-iteration agents on the wrong layout and is rejected too.
- References: quality/
